item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J00015","case1_error":"Uses George’s orange count instead of Amelia’s apple count as the base for adding five.","case2_error":"Uses Lia’s red bead count instead of her blue bead count as the base for adding seven.","reason":"Both substitute an irrelevant category’s count for the required comparison baseline.","judgment":"same"},{"pair_id":"J00016","case1_error":"Adds four weeks to weekly hours instead of multiplying weekly hours by four.","case2_error":"States an unsupported final value of 500 after correctly writing the total-hours formula.","reason":"The first writes an erroneous relation; the second gives an incorrect final number after a correct formula without showing its calculation.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00017","case1_error":"Reports packet count as peanut count, omitting multiplication by peanuts per packet.","case2_error":"Reports daily biscuit consumption as weekly consumption, omitting multiplication by school days.","reason":"Both treat one factor as the total and omit the other factor needed to aggregate equal groups.","judgment":"same"},{"pair_id":"J00018","case1_error":"States an unsupported final value of 500 after correctly writing the total-hours formula.","case2_error":"No mathematical error; correctly calculates 200 hours.","reason":"The second solution correctly answers the question, so both cases do not have diagnosable errors.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J00019","case1_error":"Reports daily biscuit consumption as weekly consumption without multiplying by five days.","case2_error":"Incorrectly evaluates the correctly written product 8 * 5 as 35.","reason":"The first omits the required aggregation; the second expresses the correct aggregation but evaluates it incorrectly.","judgment":"different"}]}
